entries.name: iOS Simulator devices
entries.hint: Per-device simulator data under this account. It is measured for relocation; the Relocation tab moves it to another volume.
entries.impact: Cleaning is disabled: deleting this folder would destroy every simulator with its apps and data.
entries.note: Relocation-only entry (CLN-27): Move/Restore happen on the Relocation tab and replace the folder with a symlink to the copy on the destination volume.
